stem:
Justin has 50 pictures in an album. Of these pictures, 30 show his friends, 12 show his family, and 8 show only Justin. Justin is in \(\frac{1}{2}\) of the pictures that show his friends and \(\frac{1}{2}\) of the pictures that show his family.

Based on this information, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The probability of randomly selecting a picture that shows Justin with his friends is greater than the probability of randomly selecting a picture that shows Justin with his family.

options.label: B
options.text: The probability of randomly selecting a picture that shows Justin is 8%.

options.label: C
options.text: The probability of randomly selecting a picture that shows Justin with his family is 5 times the probability of randomly selecting a picture that shows only his friends.

options.label: D
options.text: The probability of randomly selecting a picture that does not show Justin is 21%.
